summary: iter103 — Verified the new Name-Mismatch Report + Birth-Certificate flow end-to-end. Backend: new pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_id_docs_names_iter103.py — 11/11 passing (includes 2 real-Gemini OCR calls on synthetic PAN+Aadhaar+passport+birth-certificate PNGs). The pre-existing /app/backend/tests/test_id_docs_and_tuition.py — 18/18 still passing (no regressions). Confirmed: (a) PUT /api/members/{mid}/id-docs now accepts birth, birth_dob and pan_name/aadhaar_name/passport_name/birth_name per person; parents are rejected with 400 for any birth* field; GET returns new app_names {person: name} + app_dob. (b) POST /api/members/{mid}/id-docs/{person}/{card} saves `{card}_name` into member_id_docs.people.{p} when OCR runs; ?ocr=false deletes any prior card_name; DELETE /file clears {card}_name too. (c) card='birth' blocked for person='father/mother/guardian' at upload time (400). (d) The generic /pan/use-name and /aadhaar/use-name routes NO LONGER exist — admin_client.post returns 404 (confirmed), while /passport/use-name still works and title-cases. (e) POST /self/birth/use-dob sets users.date_of_birth; empty dob → 400; audit action is dob_from_birth_certificate. (f) GET /api/id-docs/name-report returns rows with per-card {name, scan, unread, match} dicts (birth = null for parents, dict with scan=False for self when no file) + pending_rereads integer; POST /api/id-docs/reread-names?limit=N processes a batch and returns {done, named, remaining}. Verified pan.match flips False→True→False correctly with name_exact. (g) GET /api/id-docs/report rows carry birth / birth_scan (null for parents). (h) POST /api/id-docs/bulk/read detects type='birth' and populates dob; its match only picks person='self' rows for birth. — Real OCR on synthetic birth certificate correctly extracted name='ANIKA SHARMA' and dob='2012-08-15'. Frontend (Playwright on preview): logged in as admin via toggle-admin-login + login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button. On /admin/id-documents all four tabs present (id-docs-tab-report, id-docs-tab-names, id-docs-tab-bulk, id-docs-tab-travel). Opened Name mismatch — the testids name-report, name-report-filter, name-report-search, name-report-count, name-report-reread render; filter 'all' showed 358 rows, 'any' showed 0 (preview DB has no mismatches yet, which matches the empty pending_rereads=0 baseline). On /admin/approvals the new name filter renders (approvals-name-filter, approvals-name-input populated with a 76-option datalist from member names, approvals-name-clear appears after typing and the X button successfully resets the input to ''). Code-read verification of /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/members/IdDocsSection.jsx confirmed: cardsFor('self') adds 'birth', parents skip it; the id-{p}-{card}-name-warning renders a Use passport name button ONLY for passport (line 40), everything else (aadhaar/pan/birth) is a red solid pill with no button (line 45); id-{p}-{card}-dob-diff + id-{p}-{card}-use-dob render only for card==='birth' when d.dob !== d.expected_dob; id-{p}-{card}-card-name renders the saved OCR name; use-dob button posts to /self/birth/use-dob. BulkIdUpload.jsx renders bulk-row-{key}-name-warning + bulk-mismatch-alert popup + bulk-mismatch-close as spec says (verified by file read + code review earlier). Approvals Devices filter branch could not be exercised because the preview tenant surfaces All/Leaves/Check-ins/Corrections/Access Requests as the top-level kind filter and no 'Devices' option is rendered here — the hide logic is probably correct (CSS conditional on kind==='devices'), but we couldn't trigger it live.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/id_docs.py: save_id_numbers correctly guards birth / birth_dob / birth_name behind _check(person, 'birth', people) which raises 400 for parents (SELF_ONLY tuple). GET /id-docs returns a flat `app_names` map keyed by person — nice and symmetric. Good.

routes/id_docs.py upload_scan: new `$unset` of {card}_name + {card}_name_tried on every re-upload AND on ocr=false path prevents stale names from lingering. On a successful OCR run _store_card_name writes {card}_name (if a name was read) or {card}_name_tried=true so the batch re-reader doesn't retry a scan Gemini couldn't parse — exactly the one-off semantics the spec asks for.

routes/id_docs.py: name_report() builds per-card cells with {name, scan, unread, match}. Note the `unread` flag is True only when there's a file AND no saved name — but it doesn't check `name_tried`. So a scan Gemini couldn't read will still show as 'unread' forever. This is acceptable (admin can re-upload a clearer scan), but worth flagging so the main agent decides whether to display '(couldn't read)' separately from 'not yet read'.

reread_names() uses asyncio.Semaphore(3) + asyncio.gather — polite rate-limit for Gemini. limit is clamped 1..12. One race worth noting: two admins pressing the button simultaneously will double-charge Gemini for the same files because _store_card_name only writes after Gemini returns. For a one-off migration button this is fine.

services/id_ocr.py read_id_card: when card=='birth' res['dob'] is the ISO dob — but when card=='auto' and `kind` resolves to 'birth' the res dict falls through to the generic path and dob is NOT added. If a user uploads a birth cert via /bulk/read the detector will set type='birth' but may lose the dob. Checking the test above (test_bulk_read_detects_birth_and_matches_self) the dob WAS returned, so the auto path does include dob at the top-level JSON — likely because the Gemini auto-prompt still asks for 'dob' and _parse keeps it. Still, the explicit `if kind == 'birth': res['dob'] = …` block is only applied in the non-auto branch. For defence-in-depth consider promoting it to run for `kind in ('birth', 'passport')` regardless of card parameter.

frontend IdDocsSection.jsx: cardsFor(p) + CARDS/SELF_ONLY wiring looks correct. The red solid-pill for non-passport mismatches (line 45) deliberately has NO use-name button — matches 'app name changes only from passport' rule. Nice.

frontend BulkIdUpload.jsx: MismatchAlert is only shown when any saved row's cardName !== appName (after Save all). The alert key is bulk-mismatch-{row.key} per row — matches spec. bulk-mismatch-close dismisses. The use-name button inside the row (not the alert) is scoped to card === 'passport' only (line 42-45), which is correct.

frontend NameMismatch.jsx: FILTERS object defines a 'birth' filter that calls bad(r.birth); because the backend sends birth=null for parents, bad(null) is false → parent rows won't appear in the birth filter — correct. 'nopassport' filter uses !r.passport?.name — because passport cell is null for parents too, this will also EXCLUDE parent rows. Spec didn't specify, but if PMs expect parents to appear under 'No passport name yet' this needs a tweak.
frontend NameMismatch.jsx: the Re-read button calls /id-docs/reread-names?limit=6 in a loop until remaining=0. If a single call errors out it stops (break). Good UX guarding.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (3/3 scenarios verified live — name-mismatch tab/filter/search, approvals name filter+clear+datalist, id-docs tabs; birth form slot verified by code review only because admin on preview can't reliably open the member form dialog from inside Playwright without a localStorage token name mapping)

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 via toggle-admin-login → login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates throwaway test_<hex>@ishowedup-test.example.com members (deleted by conftest sweep). Playwright created zero real-DB mutations (one failed member-create attempt via frontend fetch returned 401 because localStorage key differs — not needed; the backend tests covered the member-form API surface).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview admin's bearer token lives in localStorage under a key that is NOT 'token' or 'access_token' — Playwright code that tries to re-use it via fetch() from the page context returns 401. Use the Python requests + /api/auth/login path instead (as this iteration's pytests do). The members list on /admin/members has no data-testid on pencil edit buttons — the spec says 'double-click a row for the full form', so use `row.dblclick(force=True)` on a Member-cell to open MemberForm. On preview the name-report currently has 358 rows and 0 mismatches, so to live-test the mismatch warning you must first create a throwaway member whose full_name differs from the uploaded card_name (either upload a synthetic PNG via the member form, or seed via admin API with pan_name / aadhaar_name / passport_name / birth_name set to a different string, then open the name-report page). Birth OCR works but takes ~15-25s per call so budget 60-90s for file-input + warning-render tests. The /pan/use-name and /aadhaar/use-name endpoints are gone — spec says app name follows passport only; do not add tests that expect them. New Playwright testids to remember: id-docs-tab-{report,names,bulk,travel}; name-report / name-report-filter / name-report-search / name-report-count / name-report-reread / name-report-empty; name-row-{member_id}-{person} + -app + -{card} cells; approvals-name-filter / approvals-name-input / approvals-name-clear + datalist id 'approvals-names'; id-self-birth-{number,dob,upload,file-input,card-name,detected,use-dob,dob-diff,name-warning}; bulk-row-{key}-{card,number,member,person,name-warning,use-name,read-error,nomatch,failed,remove} + bulk-mismatch-alert / bulk-mismatch-{row.key} / bulk-mismatch-close / bulk-save-all / bulk-dropzone / bulk-file-input.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Feature works as specified. One minor UX observation in critical_code_review_comments (NameMismatch 'nopassport' filter excludes parent rows because backend sends null for parent passport cells); flag to main agent only if PMs want parents visible there.
